question: Where is the nearest hotel along the direction of travel from Cyrus Dallin Art Museum, Arlington, MA to Gallery 444, Provincetown, MA?
sql: WITH origin_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cyrus Dallin Art Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Arlington%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gallery 444%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Provincetown%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MA%' LIMIT 1 ), path_corridor AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(o.geometry, d.geometry)::geography, 5000) AS geom -- Create a 5km buffer around the direct path FROM origin_poi o, destination_poi d ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, origin_poi o_geom WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM path_corridor)::geography) ORDER BY ST_Distance(o_geom.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) LIMIT 1;
